specification.procurement_note: Project FRP shall conform to the selected resin system and the applicable ASCE/SEI 74-23 minimum physical, mechanical, and durability requirements.

physical_requirements.glass_transition_temperature_average: > 180 degF (published approximate 82 degC); actual supplied-product Tg is not fabricated

tg_project_requirement.formula: max(180 degF, maximum expected material temperature + 40 degF)

conditioning: ASTM G154 Cycle 1, UVA-340, alternating UV / condensing humidity
100 freeze-thaw cycles, ASTM C666 Procedure A
durability_requirements.longitudinal_transverse_tensile_retentio: >= 75% of characteristic values; product conformance, not a design multiplier
durability_requirements.conditioned_tg: Project-required Tg threshold; minimum five samples

factor_formulas.temperature_domain: 90 < sustained T <= 140 degF; no extrapolation above 140
factor_formulas.chemical: None declared CCH=1; specified ASTM C581 / engineer-stipulated source required
